result.title: Shared Is Not Enough: Predictor Width and Factor Readability Under Masked Latent Prediction
result.summary: Masked latent prediction methods such as I-JEPA aim to learn predictable features, but what determines which information they retain is less clear. We built a simulator in which every factor behind an image is known, so a probe can measure how readable each factor remains after training. We trained small encoders (0.7M parameters) with I-JEPA, SimCLR and BYOL on the same pairs of views and probed a factor that both views share. I-JEPA had a predictor with half the encoder's width and depth, the proportions it uses for ViT-B. Its median score was about 40% of SimCLR's. Widening the predictor to the encoder's width reversed this ordering at every training seed, against both other methods. We release the simulator and the trained models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建因子已知的可控模拟器，用同样视图对训练小型编码器（I-JEPA、SimCLR、BYOL），再用探针测量两视图共享因子的可读性。结果显示 I-JEPA 采用 ViT-B 比例的半宽浅预测器时，因子可读性中位数约为 SimCLR 的 40%；将预测器加宽至编码器等宽后，在每个训练随机种子下都反超两种对比方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 预测器宽度改变哪些因子仍可读出，可能与 LVR 中预测器容量、latent 内容保留及信息坍缩的关系相关，可供核查；但该工作限于自监督视觉表征，未涉及推理或答案使用 latent。
